question: what would the suite have caught of the rules this phase added
method: tools/mutants.py: one load-bearing change at a time, cargo test --workspace --locked after each, the tree restored between them. Six mutants were added for the new rules: the branch trigger without the peak data rate change, either rate condition weighing the previous access unit against the rate that replaced the one its bytes were carried at, the branch not reaching the other restart headers of its unit, and the two halves of the missing-container rule

survived: the missing container, the walk asking for skip bytes first

finding: the first run named a hole: the walk arm of the missing-container rule was held only by a media test, so the mutant that put it back survived every test that runs without the corpus. The rule became a named function with a unit test, and the second run catches it. The one survivor left is the matrix alignment, which the round already records as having no specification behind it
